violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers
violation_type.typical_finding: The main caregiver in the classroom fail to communicate to the caregiver coming to take over the class that a child in the classroom had a food allergy and would not be able to eat the evening snack that is serviced.

finding_variants.text: The main caregiver in the classroom fail to communicate to the caregiver coming to take over the class that a child in the classroom had a food allergy and would not be able to eat the evening snack that is serviced.
Operation did not share incident information with one another when changing staff.
Staff did not share important information regarding a child's behavior prior to the child's start date.

Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, staff failed to communicate between each other after an incident took place. This delayed a child from receiving medical attention and inaccuracy of the information provided under the incident report.

This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver departing their classroom did not relay classroom information to the incoming caregiver, resulting in uncertainty about who was responsible for the group. This led to the classroom being left unattended for at least five minutes.

The standard was evaluated for a standard investigation and was not found compliant.   Staff did not share with other caregivers that the gym area was closed due to safety hazard which resulted in a caregiver transition a group of children to the gym area causing a child to sustain an injury.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: At the time of inspection the caregivers in the infant room, could not answer any questions. The inspector returned to the classroom after the assigned caregiver returned from break to get questions answered.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During the abuse/neglect investigation it was found that a caregiver did not properly communicate to an incoming caregiver that a child was without shoes and socks resulting in the child getting injuries to the bottom of their feet when they went outside.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Through investigation, it was determined that staff did not communicate a parent's instructions for her child's meals, which resulted in the child eating food to which he was allergic.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver failed to share necessary information with an incoming caregiver by exiting the classroom without clearly communicating that they were leaving and without confirming that the incoming caregiver had assumed responsibility for the children.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver did not share pertinent information with an incoming caregiver before leaving the classroom of a child who sustained an injury while in their care.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: There is sufficient evidence to prove that a caregiver did not share information with the director or incoming caregivers about a child who had lost a tooth and had minor injuries to their lip.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the evidence obtained, there is sufficient evidence to substantiate that caregivers failed to effectively communicate with one another, which resulted in a parent's verbal request not being communicated to the appropriate caregiver and, consequently, not being received or acted upon.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The AM toddler caregiver did not communicate to the PM caregiver before ending their workday of a child that sustained a scratch.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not notify incoming caregivers of a child?s injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based off of the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the new caregiver was not informed that the school-age children were not to use blankets outside of naptime by the tenured caregivers.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. The director did not share with the incoming caregiver that a child was in the bathroom during the caregiver shift change.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver failed to ensure the continuity of care by not communicating prior behavioral concerns and supervision needs with incoming staff, which led to an incident occurring twice.
occurrences.facility_name: Primrose School of Ne Flower Mound

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, a caregiver did not share information with incoming caregivers taking responsibility of her group of children. One child sustained an injury, minutes before transitioning to a new classroom with new caregivers. None of the information about sustaining an injury was communicated to the incoming caregivers so the information could not be communicated to the parents received timely information about the injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the DFPS investigation conducted, staff did not communicate with each other about combining classrooms and how many children staff would be responsible for.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that the caregiver did not share relevant information with the incoming caregiver, including parent instructions and details about the child. As a result, continuity of care was not maintained.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient information available to determine caregivers did not consistently share information about children with the incoming caregiver during a shift change.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Afternoon caregivers were not informed by the morning caregivers that a child was not supposed to eat meat.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver failed to inform incoming caregiver of the number of children in care and a child was left at the playground.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Staff did not verify information regarding a child transportation, as a result a child put on a school bus by mistake.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was investigated as part of an DFPS investigation and found to be in non-compliance.    It was discovered that a staff member failed to communicate which children they were receiving when combining classrooms which lead to staff unaware a child was present.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: At the time of the inspection a caregiver left the room while children were sleeping without notifying the person in charge that they needed to step out. The room was within a distance and open that auditory awareness was able to be maintained.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: When a child fell outside and was crying for an extended period of time, the caregiver did not share that information with the caregiver who took over care of the child at carpool time.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Caregivers did not communicate about a child injury resulting in parent not receiving full details about the injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. A caregiver departing their classroom did not relay classroom information to the incoming caregiver, resulting in uncertainty about who was responsible for the group. This led to the classroom being left unattended for at least five minutes.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on a DFPS investigation an incoming caregiver was not informed of a biting incident which happened before she began her workday to a child who was under her care by another child who was under her care.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Clear instructions were not provided to the incoming caregiver, resulting confusion in regard to the infant's feeding.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver did not share information with another teacher informing her the ages of the infants in care.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During a CCI investigation, interviews with staff revealed that a caregiver failed to inform the incoming caregiver that a child was back in their care.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver did not share information with another teacher informing her one child was leaving. This lead the teacher mis-counting the children she was responsible for.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not share information about a child's injury with caregiver in the next shift.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Information was not shared with an incoming teacher with how many children were in care in the classroom that they were taking over.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Staff did not share important information regarding a child's behavior prior to the child's start date.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Information about a child was not shared with an incoming caregiver which resulted in the parents not knowing what happened to the child.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Information was obtained during an investigation that an incoming caregiver was not made aware that a child had been injured earlier in the day. This resulted in the child's parent not being notified at pickup as the current caregiver had not been made aware of the injury.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: One caregiver left the classroom without providing any information to the other caregiver.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Caregiver failed to share information regarding a child's injury to the closing caregiver.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Caregivers failed to provide information with incoming  caregivers and a child who is diabetic was allowed access to candy and her blood glucose levels became elevated.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on investigation it was found that a caregiver had received a group of children from another caregiver and was not provided information regarding specific incidents of a potty accident for a child in that group. This resulted in a parent not having the correct information when requesting it regarding the accident.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. Caregivers transitioning between taking over the group did not effectively communicate with each other.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver failed to inform the incoming staff or management that a child had thrown up during care.  A caregiver failed to inform the incoming staff or management that a child had been bitten.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation.    It was found that different caregivers observed concerning behaviors in a child in care and did not communicate with one another about the behaviors to ensure that the child could be supervised appropriately.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the information provided during the course of the investigation, one staff did not communicate with incoming staff that a child was asleep in a play pen. The secondary staff did not communicate with the first staff and as a result the child was left alone.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the information gained during the investigation, a caregiver failed to provide the releasing staff member with information of an incident that occurred during the child's time in care.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: One staff did not communicate with other staff about which incoming children they would be in charge of.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver did not provide information to the incoming caregiver that a child fell on a toy so parent could be notified during pick up time.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on evidence gathered, at least three caregivers who were responsible for a toddler at different times throughout the day, did not share pertinent information with each other regarding marks/bumbs seen on the toddler and incidents the toddler was involved in during their shift with the toddler.
occurrences.facility_name: Little Wishes and Big Dreams Playhouse Ltd

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that operation staff failed to ensure that staff were informed of the number of children that should be present in a classroom when they came to assist during naptime, resulting in the operation failing to identify that a child was missing for over an hour and a half.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During the course of a DFPS investigation, it was determined that staff failed to ensure that other staff were aware that children were being transitioned to their group.  This failure to communicate regarding the transition of children from one group to another resulted in a child being left on the playground unattended for approximately 30 minutes, with nobody noting the child's absence until the parent arrived to pick up the child from care.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: It was determined that information regarding a child's injury was not shared with the incoming teacher.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The standard was evaluated for a standard investigation and was not found compliant.   Staff did not share with other caregivers that the gym area was closed due to safety hazard which resulted in a caregiver transition a group of children to the gym area causing a child to sustain an injury.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: It was determined there was an incident where the caregivers did not share information with one another which cause the child to appear lost when the parent came to pick up the child.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Operation did not share incident information with one another when changing staff.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver did not provide information to the director about the total number of kids in care while transitioning children to another classroom.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on the evidence obtained during an investigation, operation staff failed to ensure that they communicated with one another prior to leaving a classroom all incidents and injuries involving a child in care resulting in parents not being notified timely of the incidents. .

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The main caregiver in the classroom fail to communicate to the caregiver coming to take over the class that a child in the classroom had a food allergy and would not be able to eat the evening snack that is serviced.
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Caregivers did not share information pertaining to injury when transitioning to another class.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: It has been determined that caregivers in a classroom did not share information about a child, resulting in the child being left unsupervised in the bathroom for 15 minutes.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.     During a transition, a caregiver did not share information regarding how many children were present to the incoming caregiver.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based off evidence gathered, caregivers were not sharing pertinent information regarding the children in their care when transitioning the children to another caregiver.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Based on evidence from a DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not communicate appropriately with another caregiver the total number of children in care prior to transitioning from a classroom.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver was observed taking children inside and the caregiver did not inform the co-teacher the number of children she was taking with her.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that caregivers did not share information about child's disposition/incident with caregivers in the next shift.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and determined to be deficient. The director did not share information provided by the parent with caregivers about the child's special needs.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A caregiver failed to communicate with a teacher that she was bringing a child to their classroom.  The caregiver opened the door and the child entered without a teacher in place.  The toddler was alone in the classroom for thirteen minutes.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was evaluated in regards to a report and found deficient. Caregivers did not share incident report with parent in a timely manner due to a lack of communication between caregivers.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The caregiver present during the incident failed to relay information to the incoming caregiver to communicate with mother about the child's incident on the playground.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: It was confirmed that a caregiver did not inform the other caregivers of a child being dropped off.  This led to the child being left unattended on the playground.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: Continuity of care was not ensured when a caregiver did not share information regarding a child with another incoming caregiver in a classroom.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: A toddler caregiver failed to communicate with the incoming caregiver and administration of a child injury that occurred while caregiver was supervising children alone in the playground.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. It was determined during the investigation that the caregiver in charge of the child did not properly communicate with the incoming staff or parent about the whereabouts of the child's device when needed. This caused confusion overall.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The AM and PM caregivers were not effectively communicating information which resulted in the child being sent home in LUVS diapers on multiple occasions.

Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: The caregiver in charge of a child who received minor scratches while in their care failed to notify the incoming caregivers of child's injuries and provide information of how the injuries happened.
